description: A Solana-native multi-agent hedge fund: spot via DFlow and Jupiter, perpetuals via Phoenix, market data via Helius and Solana Tracker, Grok (xAI) reasoning, and Supermemory/Mem0 memory. Agents run as desks (spot, perps, arbitrage, research) under a deterministic risk gate with a portfolio-manager consensus. Paper/dry-run first: venues build unsigned transactions, signing is policy-gated through per-desk OWS wallets, and x402 agent budgets are enforced by ledger. Live execution only on explicit approval.

metadata.payments: x402 on Solana (SVM) with ledger budget enforcement
